title: Services
content:
Advanced Social Media

Social media is without a doubt reaching critical mass and is commanding your attention. So what is social media, really? In a nutshell, it consists of web-based applications that allow creation, exchange, and rating of content by their users…you know Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn, Digg, and StumbleUpon.

Search Engine Optimization

With our Destin Local and National Search Engine Optimization (SEO) services, you’ll more than get noticed, you’ll be on the Front Page of Google. 83% of people don’t go past the first page of Google to find the products and services they are looking for.

We will get you on the Front Page of Google with a full suite of services and the latest local Internet marketing technologies. After all, you’ve done all that work building your business, let us make sure customers find you. We offer a full suite of Google + Local and National SEO services to place businesses in local maps, organic search and Pay Per Click services.

Web design and Web Development

We are a Florida based Web design Company, that delivers the utmost professional custom webpages, eCommerce websites and web solutions to our diverse clientele. We strive to give you the best experience in throughout the entire process of building your website. When you call us, we answer. If you miss you, we’ll get back to you in one business day. We’re responsive, we listen, and we believe in giving you full ownership of your website.

Advanced Linking Campaigns

Linking is one of the more important aspects of search engine optimization but it is often the one that is most overlooked. Linking helps the search engine spiders (crawl) find you page(s). If they can’t fine them, they don’t get spidered and this means they don’t get indexed within the search engines. We use very advanced linking campaigns and techniques that are strictly in accordance with Google Panda and the Recent Penguin updates.

Online Reputation Management

With Reputation Management we understand that there are no cookie cutter solutions, your online issues are unique to you, and the solution has to be structured to address your issues. Because the details matter, you’ll get support from our vastly experienced team, we’ll develop intelligent, original content crafted for your business, and you review and approve everything. Working together, we systematically take control of how you or your business are presented online and develop your online identity. You don’t have to live with the Internet’s propensity to keep outdated news alive forever.

Pay Per Click

Pay Per Click or a PPC campaign lets you determine exactly who comes to your website. You only pay for clicks to your site; if a person clicks on a search engine result, link, or banner and lands on your site (aka PPP pay-for-performance advertising). If the person only sees your link, but does not click through, this is called an impression.
